summary: Evaluate suppliers against mandatory requirements, observed performance and comparable total cost; plan vendor trials, contract renewal decisions, switching and credible exits.
triggers: vendor evaluation and supplier comparison with mandatory requirement gates
renew or replace a vendor before an auto renewal notice deadline
compare vendor total cost of ownership across seats usage implementation and switching
review incumbent vendor performance against SLA and support promises
supplier concentration dependency access risk and vendor lock in
design a vendor trial and verify data export before choosing a supplier
vendor exit planning offboarding migration overlap and termination costs
antiTriggers: purchase services negotiate contracts or contact suppliers
specific legal financial or regulatory advice
design customer prices and package tiers rather than evaluate suppliers
prioritize product features or roadmap opportunities without a supplier decision
claim SLA credits or revoke vendor access without a separate authorized workflow
security certification or comprehensive third party compliance audit
